provenance.question: Can an agent produce reproducible scientific analyses?

benchmark.name: reproducible-analysis
benchmark.claim: The submission produces a valid analysis from permitted observations.
benchmark.scope: Two declared task domains and their stated limits.
benchmark.progress_signal: Higher eligible score with tighter uncertainty indicates better analysis.

research_question: Can an agent produce reproducible scientific analyses under a fixed evidence and resource contract?

topology.ranking_rationale: The tracks have different oracles and are reported separately.
rejected_alternatives: single leaderboard would hide domain-specific validity

task_interface.generation_or_sourcing: organizer provenance manifest and deduplicated source pool
task_interface.release: public examples plus fresh hidden batches
task_interface.observability: declared inputs and metadata only; target evidence is hidden

allowed_resources.data: public data released with the task

scientific_validity.oracle: validated reference calculation or adjudicated measurement protocol
scientific_validity.uncertainty: per-instance interval with declared confidence level and aggregation
scientific_validity.failure_and_abstention: invalid or abstaining instances receive no objective score and are reported

evaluation.aggregation: macro-average over eligible instances with bootstrap interval
evaluation.budgets: one submission per hidden batch within the declared runtime budget
evaluation.ranking_and_ties: rank within each track; overlapping intervals tie; report no overall rank
evaluation.uncertainty_reporting: publish bootstrap 95% intervals and eligible-instance count

threat_model.residual_risk: undetected source overlap can remain and is disclosed

sustainability.fresh_hidden_tasks: issue new hidden batches from a versioned source pool
sustainability.independent_audit: an external reviewer reruns sampled submissions
sustainability.reproducibility: publish manifests, hashes, seeds, and environment lock
sustainability.versioning: increment specification and task-set versions; never silently change scoring

records.question: Should tracks share an overall rank?

examples.invalid: withheld input or failed physical constraint is rejected
examples.adversarial: near-duplicate memorization is detected and rejected
scoring_walkthroughs: invalid: gate fails and receives no rank
adversarial: proxy score is discarded after audit
